passage:
Gil is in a big lab. 
Gil got lost in the big lab. 
The lamp in the lab is not on. 
Gil can not see.

“Help!” said Gil. 
Mel gets to the lab. 
Mel can help. 
Mel taps the lamp.

The lamp is on. 
Gil can see! 
Mel hands Gil his books. 
Gil left the lab.
